_doc: Commits a NEXT nightly must not ship without their fix. nightly.yml's publish-nightly (Final publication gate) reads this file live from feat-cmux-next just before it publishes, and holds a build whose commit contains a listed 'bad' without its 'fix' (scripts/ci/nightly_publish_guard.py known-bad). Full SHAs only. Landing a pair here holds every run that has not yet published, including runs that started before it landed.
